korea-realestate.name: Korea Real Estate MCP Server
korea-realestate.description: Provides query and search tools for Korea's 20-year real estate and interest rate factors.

tools.name: get_factors_by_year
tools.description: Retrieve economic indicators and real estate factors for a specific year (between 2006 and 2025).

tools.name: get_factors_range
tools.description: Retrieve economic indicators and real estate factors for a range of years.

tools.name: get_all_factors
tools.description: Retrieve the entire 20-year history of Korean economic indicators and real estate factors.
